text:
alec: Heads up — noticed a small but recurring billing spike tied to SSE reconnects through our multiplexed proxy. Looks like resumed sessions sometimes get charged twice.
monica: ugh, any idea why? is it resume vs new-session detection failing at the proxy layer?
jamal: yep. repro so far: client resumes, proxy opens a new backend socket (different physical conn) and our billing layer attributes tokens to the new socket id rather than the resume-id/tenant header.
alec: infra-bot flagged a pattern earlier this morning — dump attached in prod-alert. infra-bot: alert: unusual token delta for tenant-ops between 08:04-08:10 UTC (sampled)
lucy: can you paste the sample trace? need to know which headers we're losing across the proxy.
jamal: here's a trimmed trace:
```
CLIENT -> PROXY: GET /stream (Cookie=xxx, X-Resume-ID=rid-42, X-Tenant=tenant-ops)
PROXY -> BACKEND: GET /stream (Cookie stripped, new-socket-id=socket-8893)
BACKEND: accepts, issues tokens under socket-8893
```
kevin: so we lose resume metadata in the proxy->backend hop. That explains misattribution. Do we strip on purpose for privacy, or bug?
monica: proxy strips cookies/headers by default for multiplex safety. We added a header whitelist but resume headers weren't included when we enabled connection pooling.
alec: oh nice catch. That change was to prevent leaking auth between multiplexed clients. But we should preserve resume metadata (resume-id + tenant) since it's internal and needed for billing/quota routing.
jamal: quick patch idea: add an internal-only header `X-Resume-Context: base64(json)` that the proxy copies when it demuxes. minimal surface and togglable.
lucy: alternative: attribute billing at request-level upstream (i.e., when token is consumed incrementing the tenant counter based on an initial mapping table of resume-id->tenant). That would tolerate transient header stripping.
kevin: mapping table needs to be strongly consistent and cleaned up when sessions close; risk of leak if resume-id is spoofed.
monica: true. we already have resume registry in route-manager for sticky routes; could piggyback on that.
sre-oncall: from SRE POV, adding header copying is lower-risk and faster to roll; mapping table might increase memory pressure but gives more decoupling.
alec: UX/console implications: right now console shows token-by-socket and per-route charts. We'll need to update console to dedupe resume-level charges when we fix attribution, otherwise customers will see a mismatch.
lucy: propose 2-step: (1) quick roll: proxy whitelist to copy `X-Resume-ID` + `X-Tenant` to internal headers (canary), (2) medium: migrate billing to resume-id registry and update console aggregation to show "resume-deduped tokens" toggle.
jamal: I'll draft the proxy whitelist patch. should we gate behind `feature.proxy_preserve_resume=true`?
kevin: yes. feature flag + canary in us-west1 for a day, monitor resume duplication rate and bill delta.
alec: add telemetry hooks: increment metric `stream.resume_header_missing` when backend sees no resume header but session claims resume in payload, and `billing.charge_probe_mismatch` when token attribution doesn't match resume registry.
monica: also add a console alert card: "High duplicate token attribution" with links to traces and sample connection IDs.
sre-oncall: for canary runbook: if duplicate charge delta > 1% baseline OR error rate + latency spike, rollback flag.
jamal: patch ready in a1 hour. I'll include unit tests for header pass-through and an E2E instrumentation script using the dev-traffic generator.
lucy: I'll sketch console change — new aggregation layer that rolls up socket->resume mapping and a toggle to show both raw and deduped views. PM wants a note in release that downstream billing numbers may shift for affected windows.
alec: timeline: patch -> canary 24h -> if green, expand fleetwide -> follow-on billing migration over 2 weeks.
kevin: small gotcha: websocket path differs from SSE; make sure proxy logic covers both `Upgrade: websocket` and chunked SSE demux path.
jamal: noted. tests will cover WS and SSE. also adding sample logs:
```
INFO proxy: demux: copied headers for resume-id=rid-42 tenant=tenant-ops socket=8893
WARN backend.billing: missing_resume_header for socket=8894 possible-multiplex
```
monica: thanks team. after canary, ops should run diffed billing reports and mark affected invoices if needed.
alec: ok I'll coordinate comms with finance and support so customers aren't surprised. tagging @support for FYI.
support: noted. we'll draft a proactive message if we see >0.5% of active tenants impacted.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: feature.proxy_preserve_resume=true -> canary(us-west1) at 2026-03-20T15:30:00Z
alec: awesome. follow-ups in #eng-platform-daily tomorrow. :thumbsup:
